const STRIP=['_pendEmail','_pendSlot','_mv','_mvCol','_wasDone','_preserved','_blanked'];
return $input.all().map(i=>{ const j={...i.json}; for(const k of STRIP) delete j[k]; return {json:j}; });

const baseId=$('Params In').first().json['Clayroots Base ID']; const tableId=$('Params In').first().json['Table ID']; const out=[]; for(const it of $input.all()){ const v=it.json; if(v.Status==='verifying' && v._pendEmail){ out.push({ json:{ rowId:v.id, email:v._pendEmail, slot:v._pendSlot, tableId, baseId } }); } } return out;
